beats.idea: Face value versus recognition and purchasing power
beats.shows: ₹100 note with two question marks
beats.template_note: Questions introduce purchasing power and recognition; no transaction is narrated.

beats.idea: Accessible recognition uses touch, numerals and size
beats.shows: Fingertip traces relief; numerals and sizes compare
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknotes accessibility raised printing identification marks large numerals size comparison
beats.template_note: Appear note details; move fingertip across raised printing and identification marks; compare numeral sizes and actual note dimensions without inventing denominations.

beats.idea: Light reveals embedded watermark and security thread
beats.shows: Backlight reveals watermark and inscribed embedded thread
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknote transmitted light Gandhi watermark security thread भारत RBI denomination macro
beats.template_note: Move note against light; reveal embedded watermark separately from printed portrait area; enlarge thread until भारत, RBI and its denomination inscription are legible.

beats.idea: Angle-dependent image differs from aligned register
beats.shows: Tilt reveals image; backlighting joins register halves
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknote latent image viewing angle see through register front reverse transmitted light
beats.template_note: Move note through viewing angles to reveal latent image; separately show front and back register fragments, then move into registered overlap against light to form the denomination.

beats.idea: Magnification reveals letters; tilt changes ink colour
beats.shows: Lens resolves letters; tilted ink changes colour
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknote micro lettering RBI denomination macro optically variable ink two viewing angles
beats.template_note: Move lens over micro-lettering and reveal readable letters; compare with blurred copy detail. Move higher-denomination note between angles and transform ink colour using verified imagery; briefly move shiny card similarly. Compare colour change with latent-image appearance, not a payment.

beats.idea: Raised ink and growing digit sizes
beats.shows: Finger traces raised ink and growing digits
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknote intaglio raised ink macro number panel ascending numeral size
beats.template_note: Move fingertip across a magnified raised-ink detail beside flat paper; then move a tracing marker along the actual number panel. Keep digit values unchanged while showing their increasing printed size.

beats.idea: Internal, fine-print and tactile checks complement
beats.shows: Internal detail, fine print, fingertip on relief
beats.image_wanted: banknote internal security detail fine printing intaglio relief comparison
beats.template_note: A comparison of check types, not a handover or new checking sequence.

beats.idea: Combine checks without assuming identical features
nouns: banknotes of different denominations and designs
beats.shows: Different note designs beside their feature details
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknotes different denominations designs verified security feature comparison
beats.template_note: A combined-check reminder and variation warning; no specific checking action is narrated.

beats.idea: Recall the four checking actions
beats.shows: Backlight, tilted note, lens, fingertip in sequence
beats.template_note: Appear four numbered views in spoken order: note against light, note at changed angle, lens over note, fingertip touching note; connect with arrows as a recall route, not a mandatory testing order.

beats.idea: Three distinct ₹1-note roles
beats.shows: ₹1 issuer, signature, and RBI circulation shown separately
beats.image_wanted: Indian one rupee note obverse Finance Secretary signature
beats.template_note: Appear ₹1 note beside Government of India issuer symbol; highlight Finance Secretary signature area; then move the note between note holder and bank staff under a separate RBI circulation bracket. Never move it from RBI as issuer.

beats.idea: Reverse panel has fifteen languages
beats.shows: Reverse panel enlarged; fifteen entries; RBI reference beside
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknote reverse language panel fifteen languages
beats.template_note: Appear the note reverse; move a magnified panel beside it; appear fifteen entry markers aligned with the actual panel entries; show the reference address paisaboltahai.rbi.org.in on a browser symbol at website. Do not fabricate website content.

beats.idea: Panel fifteen, whole note seventeen
beats.shows: Fifteen panel markers plus two front markers: seventeen
beats.image_wanted: Indian banknote front Hindi English reverse language panel
beats.template_note: Retain fifteen markers grouped inside the reverse-panel boundary; appear Hindi and English markers beside the front; compare panel count 15 with a whole-note bracket enclosing all 17. Keep the two front markers outside the panel boundary.

beats.idea: Reference features; distinguish circulation from issuance
beats.shows: Features matched; ₹1 circulation and issuance kept separate
beats.image_wanted: Indian one rupee note verified denomination features
beats.template_note: Compare denomination-specific note details with the RBI reference using matched detail pointers. Then show ₹1 beneath two distinct role slots: RBI circulation and Government of India issuer; put a cross on an RBI issuer attribution at नहीं.

beats.idea: Reject both statement traps
beats.shows: Panel seventeen crossed; RBI issuer crossed; circulation retained
beats.template_note: Show panel with 17 tag before गलत; refuse that tag at गलत and reveal 15. Beside ₹1, compare RBI circulation and issuer role tags; refuse the RBI issuer attribution while retaining circulation.

beats.idea: Recall counts, roles and reference
beats.shows: Fifteen plus two; three roles; RBI reference
beats.image_wanted: Indian one rupee note Finance Secretary signature
beats.template_note: Static recap, not a new process: retain the 15-plus-2 grouping, three separately labelled institutional roles and RBI reference browser symbol.

beats.idea: Face value settles the bill
beats.shows: ₹100 note accepted; bill balance falls to ₹0.
beats.template_note: appear bill ₹100 and genuine ₹100 note; hold customer note; give customer to shopkeeper note at दो; accept note at लिया; meter outstanding from ₹100 to ₹0 at ₹0; show_text on note face-value tag ₹100 at लिखे.

beats.idea: The bearer changes, not the note
beats.shows: Same ₹20 note passes through three unnamed holders.
beats.template_note: hold customer ₹20 note; show tea seller and milk seller note-possession counters initially ₹0; give customer to tea seller at दिया, updating tea seller to ₹20; give tea seller to milk seller at दिया, updating tea seller to ₹0 and milk seller to ₹20. Replay counter changes at बारी-बारी if needed; keep the same note unchanged and actors without personal names.

beats.idea: No interest; spending transfers possession
beats.shows: Wallet interest stays zero; ₹100 transfers for groceries.
beats.template_note: appear wallet with ₹100 note and question mark at interest; show_text interest counter ₹0 at नहीं; hold customer note; show shopkeeper note-possession counter initially ₹0; give customer to shopkeeper note at दिया and groceries in return; meter customer note-possession ₹100 to ₹0 at बचे; meter shopkeeper note-possession ₹0 to ₹100 at मिले.

beats.idea: Written promise is not currency payment
beats.shows: Written promise precedes currency payment; debt reaches zero.
beats.template_note: appear debt counter ₹500; show_text on written undertaking ‘₹500 • बिना शर्त’; give buyer to creditor undertaking at देता; keep debt ₹500; give buyer to creditor ₹500 currency at चुका; meter outstanding debt ₹500 to ₹0 at ₹0; compare written undertaking and currency side by side with ≠ at अलग.

beats.idea: Guaranteed amount; possession enables payment
beats.shows: Guaranteed face value; bearer passes note onward
beats.template_note: Appear currency note; highlight its printed amount at 'face value'; show RBI guarantee seal linked to the Promise Clause and that amount at 'guarantee'. Hold note with holder at 'Bearer'; show no personal-name requirement. Give the same note from holder to payment recipient at 'अगले payment'. Do not invent an amount.

beats.idea: Zero interest, unnamed holder, nominal promise
beats.shows: Note grouped with zero-interest and unnamed-holder cues
beats.template_note: Classification rather than a transaction: group a 0% indicator, a separate blank holder-name field and nominal-amount highlight around the note held by its bearer. The blank field is explanatory, not printed on the note.

beats.idea: Written unconditional promise; currency explicitly excluded
beats.shows: Section four: written promise; currency notes crossed
beats.template_note: Appear law book with Section 4 extract; show written undertaking linked to the short label 'बिना शर्त'. Appear bank-note and currency-note icons beside the exclusion wording before 'बाहर'; refuse both at 'बाहर'. Label the displayed wording 'extract', with no implication that this is the entire definition.

beats.idea: Conditional promise and two misleading equivalences rejected
beats.shows: Conditional promise crossed; two false equivalences rejected
beats.template_note: Appear crop linked to promise slip 'अच्छी फसल → भुगतान'; refuse its 'unconditional' badge at the first 'नहीं'. Compare bearer currency note with ordinary investment bond certificate using ≠ at 'ordinary investment bond नहीं'. Show a transaction trail beside the anonymous-bearer cue; refuse the universal claim 'हर transaction untraceable' at the final 'नहीं', leaving the trail visible.

beats.idea: Keep amount, bearer and legal category separate
beats.shows: Amount, bearer, legal category occupy separate compartments
beats.template_note: Three separated compartments show the note's amount, its bearer and its legal classification document. Beside them, a statutory-definition document has only a small excerpt highlighted and a 'पूरी definition नहीं' tag; this is a scope reminder, not a process.

beats.idea: Hypothetical note redemption for silver
beats.shows: Holder returns note; counter releases labelled silver.
beats.template_note: appear counter with persistent 'Hypothetical—not historical rate' sign; hold ₹100 note by holder; give note from holder to authority staff; give 10 grams silver from staff to holder.

beats.idea: Redemption reduces stock and cancels liability
beats.shows: Stock falls; note cancels; colonial metal promise appears.
beats.template_note: Keep hypothetical example separate: appear silver stock labelled 100 grams; give 10 grams silver from authority staff to holder; meter stock from 100 to 90 grams. Cross returned note with 'Cancelled', then meter liability from ₹100 to ₹0. At 'Colonial era', reveal undated timeline entry with gold/silver bars and coins linked to a conversion-promise label. Compare a full-bodied coin's metal value with its stated value using ≈.

beats.idea: Rules, not paper weight, fixed redemption
beats.shows: Rule determines metal; paper-weight and modern-redemption routes crossed.
beats.template_note: appear historical note, conversion-rule document and metal allotment as a connected route; at 'नियम' accept conversion-rule route. At 'नहीं' refuse paper-weighing-scale route to metal quantity. At 'modern note' compare historical and modern notes; at 'नहीं' cross modern note-to-metal redemption arrow, not the note itself.

beats.idea: Old redemption sequence recap
beats.shows: Note returned; metal received; returned note cancelled.
beats.template_note: Show numbered sequence: at 'लौटाओ' give note from holder to authority staff; at 'लो' give metal from authority staff to holder; at 'cancel' place cancellation cross on returned note.

beats.idea: दो historical currencies, साझा metal link
beats.shows: Dollar और Pound, दोनों से metal तक रास्ते
beats.template_note: Historical linkage is compared; no actual redemption transaction is narrated. Use labelled schematic notes, not purported archival designs.

beats.idea: वही ₹100, कम चावल
beats.shows: वही ₹100; चावल पाँच से चार किलो
beats.template_note: appear: ₹100 note beside five 1 kg rice portions and ₹20/kg tag; show_text: change price tag to ₹25/kg; appear: after-panel with the same ₹100 denomination and four 1 kg portions; compare: five kilograms before versus four after; show_text: separate five-kilogram group requires ₹125; show_text: question mark beside the unchanged note on 'क्या'.

beats.idea: Face value स्थिर, purchasing power कम
beats.shows: Face value स्थिर; शक्ति घटे; metal-link कटा
beats.template_note: appear: modern note with fixed face-value tag; meter: purchasing-power bar falls without a numeric value; appear: separate metal-redemption entitlement document; compare: modern note versus gold and silver, with crossed connecting lines labelled 'weight-linked नहीं'. Keep the entitlement separate, not attached to the modern note.

beats.idea: Promise clause, legal promissory note नहीं
beats.shows: Promise घिरा; legal-category entry पर cross
beats.template_note: appear: currency note with promise clause highlighted, beside a category box marked 'legal promissory note ?'; refuse: cross the proposed category entry on 'नहीं', not the note's validity; appear: Section 4 document with the exclusion highlighted; compare: similar promise wording versus different legal category.

beats.idea: Price example और redemption की सीमाएँ
beats.shows: Cash स्थिर; single-good अलग; official-only gold रास्ता
beats.template_note: meter: price indicator rises while cash stack stays unchanged; compare: a single-good price panel versus a multi-good price panel with ≠, without introducing specific goods; appear: Bretton Woods dollar-to-gold redemption path beside foreign official holder; accept: official-holder access on 'लिए'; refuse: retail-bearer access on 'नहीं'. Keep this historical panel distinct from modern currency.

beats.idea: Wording और statutory category अलग पढ़ो
beats.shows: Promise clause बनाम bracketed statutory exclusion
beats.template_note: Reading guidance, not a transaction: show promise wording beside a law document, with brackets around a labelled exclusion. Do not invent statutory wording.

beats.idea: Currency के चार स्वतंत्र tests
beats.shows: एक note, चार अलग test खानों में
beats.template_note: Static synthesis: one note anchors four separate visual cells, labelled face value, purchasing power, metal redemption and legal category. Four tests do not imply four affirmative properties.

book_pictures.title: Photograph of a ₹100 note's promise and signature area

beats.idea: Promise above, signature below
beats.relation_note: Spatial placement within the specimen, not geographic location.
beats.shows: Upper promises highlighted; lower signature boxed.

beats.idea: Same ₹100 promise to the bearer
beats.relation_note: Both language versions promise the same amount to whoever holds the note.
beats.shows: Matching ₹100 promises; ₹200 crossed; bearer holds note.
beats.template_note: appear Hindi and English promise crops side by side; compare their highlighted amounts with = and ₹100 tags; appear ₹200 amount then refuse it on नहीं; highlight I PROMISE TO PAY on वादा; appear note holder holding ₹100 note and connect THE BEARER to holder on रखने.

beats.idea: Specimen signatory versus ₹1 signing role
beats.relation_note: Separate note-and-signatory slots distinguish the ₹100 specimen from the ₹1 rule.
beats.shows: Specimen signature enlarged; ₹1 paired with Secretary.
beats.template_note: sign करते हैं states the signing role, not a signing demonstration; show a static comparison with specimen-only labeling, not a current-office claim.

beats.idea: Identify amount, bearer and signatory
beats.relation_note: Three identification prompts attach to their corresponding visual evidence.
beats.shows: Question markers beside amount, bearer, signature.

beats.idea: Read both amounts, then the signatory
beats.relation_note: Numbered reading path through the existing crop.
beats.shows: Matching amounts linked; arrow descends to signature.
beats.template_note: appear numbered highlights on both promise amounts; compare Hindi and English amounts with =; move a reading marker from the paired amounts down to the signature on नीचे.

beats.idea: Independent note identification is an accessibility need
beats.shows: Customer at counter; banknote beside question mark.
beats.template_note: A difficulty and need are posed; no transaction occurs.

beats.idea: RBI launched free MANI on 1 January 2020
beats.shows: Dated RBI milestone connects MANI phone and banknote.
beats.template_note: Launch is a dated milestone, not a demonstrated process; label MANI, its expansion, and Free.

beats.idea: Phones can assist banknote identification
beats.shows: Banknote connects through MANI phone to identification tick.
beats.template_note: Shows the assistance relationship, not an unsupported scanning or app-operation sequence.

beats.idea: Recall RBI and the launch date
beats.shows: MANI launch milestone: RBI, 1 January 2020.
beats.template_note: Recalls the existing milestone; no launch process is enacted.

beats.idea: Independent denomination recognition
beats.shows: User holds banknotes; MANI reveals their denominations.
beats.template_note: Hold banknote before user's MANI phone; show denomination question, then reveal matching ₹100 or ₹500 label on phone. Repeat with the other note; do not imply a payment.

beats.idea: Offline access across platforms and languages
beats.shows: Installed MANI: two platforms, crossed internet, 15 languages.
beats.template_note: Show MANI installed on phone; reveal Android and iOS symbols. Cross internet connection at 'बिना internet' while the app remains active. Reveal selector marked 15 with Hindi and English visible; do not invent remaining languages.

beats.idea: App languages differ from banknote languages
beats.shows: Phone languages 15 versus banknote languages 15+2.
beats.template_note: A static comparison separates two language counts; platform and language choices are access features, not a narrated transaction.

beats.idea: Nonvisual feedback and offline operation
beats.shows: MANI phone: sound waves, vibration, crossed network.
beats.template_note: Reveal sound waves at 'Audio'; move phone slightly back and forth at 'vibration'. At 'offline', cross the network symbol while keeping feedback symbols active. Do not invent a denomination output.

beats.idea: Recognition is not authentication
beats.shows: Denomination recognition ticked; authenticity checking crossed out.
beats.template_note: Show banknote linked to MANI; tick its denomination label at 'पहचानता'. Show authenticity-check magnifier beside the note, then cross the checking symbol at 'नहीं'. Never cross the banknote itself or imply it is counterfeit.

book_pictures.title: Four panels in a two-by-two grid

beats.idea: Note image से सुलभ जवाब
beats.shows: Note image enters phone; sound or vibration emerges.
beats.template_note: appear(phone, banknote); on 'image': move(banknote image, into phone); on 'sound': appear(sound waves beside phone); on 'vibration': appear(vibration marks around phone). Show alternative output branches, not money travelling.

beats.idea: Either side input; denomination सुनाई देती है
beats.shows: Either note side feeds camera; denomination sounds.
beats.template_note: appear(banknote front, banknote back as alternatives); on 'scan': move(banknote image, into phone camera); on 'Audio': appear(sound waves); show_text(on sound waves, 'Denomination'); on 'जरूरी नहीं': show_text(on phone screen, 'पढ़ना जरूरी नहीं'). No payment scanner or invented denomination.

beats.idea: Vibration महसूस होती है; installed app offline चलता है
nouns: user with vision and hearing impairment
beats.shows: Hand feels vibration; installed app needs no network.
beats.template_note: hold(user, phone); on 'vibration': appear(vibration marks at phone-hand contact); on 'installed': appear(installed app icon on phone); on 'offline use': refuse(network icon), keeping app icon active; on 'offline download नहीं': appear(download arrow), then refuse(download arrow). Keep the download rejection separate from the working installed app.

beats.idea: Image input; hearing या touch output
beats.shows: Image branches toward ear and phone-holding hand.
beats.template_note: Static input-output recap, not a fresh scanning demonstration; arrows connect the image to alternative hearing and touch outputs.

beats.idea: Camera से input, दो output रास्ते
beats.shows: Camera input branches into sound or vibration.
beats.template_note: on 'camera': appear(phone camera, banknote image); move(banknote image, into phone camera); on 'sound': appear(sound waves at first output branch); on 'vibration': appear(vibration marks at alternative output branch). Emphasize input-to-output direction without placing sound before vibration as sequential steps.

beats.idea: बनावट, promise और tool अलग हैं
beats.shows: Note texture, promise clause, phone in separate slots.
